transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: The Dubai Metro Red Line runs from terminals 1 and 3. Hours: Mon–Thu and Sat from 5:00 to midnight, Fri from 5:00 to 1:00, Sun from 8:00 to midnight; on holidays sometimes longer. Tickets and Nol cards are sold at ticket offices and machines in terminals 1 and 3. No more than two pieces of baggage, including hand luggage, are allowed on the metro.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Dubai Taxi Company taxis are available round the clock at the ranks at each terminal, flag fall from 25 AED plus a distance charge. Uber, Careem and Bolt also operate; follow the signs to the pick-up point.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: dnata left luggage is open round the clock in terminals 1, 2 and 3. For 12 hours or less: in terminals 1 and 2 a standard item (up to 21×24×11 inches) is 40 AED, a large or valuable item 50 AED; in terminal 3 — 35 and 40 AED. In terminal 1 left luggage is on the arrivals level, next to the Boots pharmacy.
